newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power Surry 2 power plant trips off.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power Surry 2 power plant trips off.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 2 nuclear power plant tripped off line and is currently in "hot shutdown," the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.

The plant tripped early Friday while the operator was in the process of reducing power for a nine-day planned maintenance outage to repair a leaking pipe in the reactor coolant system, a company official said.
"We plan to be back on line December 21," said company spokesman Jim Norvelle.
Asked if the company would have to buy spot power to meet demand, Norvelle said "We should be OK. It's pretty mild here and we had plenty of time to prepare (for the outage)."
The plant, in Gravel Neck, Va., was producing at its full rated capacity early Thursday.
Virginia Power Co is a unit of Dominion Resources Inc.
The neighboring unit, Surry 1, was still operating at full capacity, the NRC said.
